title: Working Couple in Yard, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo, 1948 USA
description: A vintage black and white candid snapshot taken on August 1, 1948, depicting a couple standing outside in a grassy yard in front of a home. The man is dressed in rugged work trousers and a button-up shirt with rolled sleeves while holding a striped cap, while the woman wears a patterned dress overlaid with a floral apron. In the background, a younger woman wearing 1940s high-waisted cuffed pants stands near the house.
